item.title: October 7, 1984: The Charles Munroe Brown house collapses on the MacArthur Causeway (with Don Slesnick) - This Day in Miami History
item.description: In today's episode of This Day in Miami History, we look at the collapse of the Charles Munroe Brown House on the MacArthur Causeway.

item.title: November 8, 1960: 10 voters choose to create Islandia, an unlikely Dade County city - This Day in Miami History
item.description: In today's episode of This Day in Miami History, we review Islandia, a city that unintentionally helped create Biscayne National Park.

item.description: We speak with Whit and Sterling McLamore about James McLamore, the co-founder of Burger King and one of Miami-Dade's greatest philanthropists.

item.title: January 30, 1952: President Harry S. Truman signs Interama proclamation - This Day in Miami History
item.description: We look at Interama, the proposed trade and culture exchange that could have changed Miami, but never actually got built.
